lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上次說的那個房間，決定租了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上次说的那个房间，决定租了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng cì shuō de nàge fángjiān, juédìng zū le ma?
lines.english: That room you mentioned last time: have you decided to rent it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那個房間很符合我的需要，又安靜，離學校也近。只不過房東要我一次付半年的房租，我現在拿不出那麼多錢。
lines.simplified: 那个房间很符合我的需要，又安静，离学校也近。只不过房东要我一次付半年的房租，我现在拿不出那么多钱。
lines.pinyin: Nàge fángjiān hěn fúhé wǒ de xūyào, yòu ānjìng, lí xuéxiào yě jìn. Zhǐbúguò fángdōng yào wǒ yí cì fù bànnián de fángzū, wǒ xiànzài ná bù chū nàme duō qián.
lines.english: That room suits my needs well: it's quiet and close to school. It's just that the landlord wants six months' rent at once, and I can't come up with that much money right now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你可以跟房東溝通看看，問他能不能一個月一個月付。
lines.simplified: 你可以跟房东沟通看看，问他能不能一个月一个月付。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ gēn fángdōng gōutōng kànkàn, wèn tā néng bù néng yí ge yuè yí ge yuè fù.
lines.english: You could try talking it over with the landlord and ask whether you can pay month by month.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我問過了。他說一個月一個月收太麻煩，不過答應我先付三個月，剩下的下個月再付。
lines.simplified: 我问过了。他说一个月一个月收太麻烦，不过答应我先付三个月，剩下的下个月再付。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ wèn guò le. Tā shuō yí ge yuè yí ge yuè shōu tài máfán, búguò dāyìng wǒ xiān fù sān ge yuè, shèng xià de xià ge yuè zài fù.
lines.english: I've asked. He said collecting it month by month is too much trouble, but he agreed that I pay three months first and the rest next month.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 房東最後答應男的怎麼付房租？
prompt.simplified: 房东最后答应男的怎么付房租？
prompt.pinyin: Fángdōng zuìhòu dāyìng nán de zěnme fù fángzū?
prompt.english: In the end, how did the landlord agree the man could pay the rent?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Àn yuè fù fángzū.
choices.english: Pay the rent month by month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bànnián de fángzū fēn liǎng cì fù.
choices.english: Pay the six months' rent in two parts.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí cì fù wán bànnián de fángzū.
choices.english: Pay all six months' rent at once.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān zhù sān ge yuè zài fù fángzū.
choices.english: Live there three months first, then pay.

questions.why: The problem after 只不過 is the landlord's demand for six months at once. Asked again, he turned down month-by-month as too much trouble (her idea) but agreed to three months now and the rest next month: two payments. He never offered to let him move in before paying.

focus.en: it's just that…; the final arrangement

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳在看什麼？是旅遊簡介嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在看什么？是旅游简介吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài kàn shénme? Shì lǚyóu jiǎnjiè ma?
lines.english: What are you looking at? A travel brochure?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，我想帶爺爺奶奶去花蓮玩三天。這個行程安排得很好，只不過每天早上六點就得出發，他們年紀大了，恐怕受不了。
lines.simplified: 对，我想带爷爷奶奶去花莲玩三天。这个行程安排得很好，只不过每天早上六点就得出发，他们年纪大了，恐怕受不了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng dài yéye nǎinai qù Huālián wán sān tiān. Zhège xíngchéng ānpái de hěn hǎo, zhǐbúguò měi tiān zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù děi chūfā, tāmen niánjì dà le, kǒngpà shòu bù liǎo.
lines.english: Yes, I want to take Grandpa and Grandma to Hualien for three days. This itinerary is well planned; it's just that it leaves at six every morning. They're old, and I'm afraid they couldn't take it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那換這一家吧。每天九點才出發，價錢也差不多。
lines.simplified: 那换这一家吧。每天九点才出发，价钱也差不多。
lines.pinyin: Nà huàn zhè yì jiā ba. Měi tiān jiǔ diǎn cái chūfā, jiàqián yě chàbùduō.
lines.english: Then switch to this one. They don't leave until nine every day, and the price is about the same.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，我晚上先問問爺爺奶奶，看他們比較喜歡哪一個。
lines.simplified: 好啊，我晚上先问问爷爷奶奶，看他们比较喜欢哪一个。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ wǎnshàng xiān wènwèn yéye nǎinai, kàn tāmen bǐjiào xǐhuān nǎ yí ge.
lines.english: OK, this evening I'll ask Grandpa and Grandma first and see which one they prefer.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼對第一個行程不太滿意？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么对第一个行程不太满意？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme duì dì yī ge xíngchéng bú tài mǎnyì?
prompt.english: Why isn't the woman quite happy with the first itinerary?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiàqián bǐ dì èr jiā guì bù shǎo.
choices.english: It costs a lot more than the second company's.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 每天九點才出發太晚了
choices.simplified: 每天九点才出发太晚了
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān jiǔ diǎn cái chūfā tài wǎn le.
choices.english: Leaving at nine every day is too late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yéye nǎinai bù xiǎng qù Huālián.
choices.english: Her grandparents don't want to go to Hualien.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà yéye nǎinai tǐlì bú gòu.
choices.english: She fears her grandparents won't have the stamina.

questions.why: After 只不過 she names the catch: six o'clock starts that her elderly grandparents 恐怕受不了 (may not have the strength for). Nine o'clock belongs to the second company, whose price is 差不多 (about the same), and nobody says the grandparents dislike Hualien.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼還在公司？不是說今天要早點回家嗎？
lines.simplified: 你怎么还在公司？不是说今天要早点回家吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme hái zài gōngsī? Bú shì shuō jīntiān yào zǎo diǎn huíjiā ma?
lines.english: Why are you still at the office? Didn't you say you were going home early today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來是。可是小李填表的時候寫錯了，每一筆都多了一個零，害我得一家一家打電話跟客人說明。
lines.simplified: 本来是。可是小李填表的时候写错了，每一笔都多了一个零，害我得一家一家打电话跟客人说明。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái shì. Kěshì Xiǎo Lǐ tián biǎo de shíhòu xiě cuò le, měi yì bǐ dōu duō le yí ge líng, hài wǒ děi yì jiā yì jiā dǎ diànhuà gēn kèrén shuōmíng.
lines.english: I was going to. But Xiao Li made mistakes when he filled in the form: every entry has an extra zero, so now I have to phone the customers one by one and explain.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小李做事一向很可靠，怎麼會這樣？要我幫忙嗎？
lines.simplified: 小李做事一向很可靠，怎么会这样？要我帮忙吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zuòshì yíxiàng hěn kěkào, zěnme huì zhèyàng? Yào wǒ bāngmáng ma?
lines.english: Xiao Li has always been so reliable. How did this happen? Do you want me to help?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他說最近太累了。不用幫忙了，只剩兩家。妳先走吧，別忘了明天早上的會議。
lines.simplified: 他说最近太累了。不用帮忙了，只剩两家。你先走吧，别忘了明天早上的会议。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō zuìjìn tài lèi le. Búyòng bāngmáng le, zhǐ shèng liǎng jiā. Nǐ xiān zǒu ba, bié wàng le míngtiān zǎoshàng de huìyì.
lines.english: He says he's been too tired lately. No need to help, only two are left. You go ahead, and don't forget tomorrow morning's meeting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼還沒下班？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么还没下班？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme hái méi xiàbān?
prompt.english: Why hasn't the man gone home yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他把表上的數字寫錯了
choices.simplified: 他把表上的数字写错了
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ biǎo shàng de shùzì xiě cuò le.
choices.english: He wrote the wrong numbers on the form.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他得準備明天早上的會議
choices.simplified: 他得准备明天早上的会议
choices.pinyin: Tā děi zhǔnbèi míngtiān zǎoshàng de huìyì.
choices.english: He has to prepare for tomorrow morning's meeting.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他在處理同事填錯的表
choices.simplified: 他在处理同事填错的表
choices.pinyin: Tā zài chǔlǐ tóngshì tián cuò de biǎo.
choices.english: He is sorting out a form a colleague filled in wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài děng nǚ de lái xiézhù tā.
choices.english: He is waiting for the woman to come and help him.

questions.why: 害我得一家一家打電話: Xiao Li, a colleague, filled in the form wrong, so the man has to phone every customer. He did not write the numbers himself, the meeting is only tomorrow, and he turned down the woman's offer of help.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是今天去臺北參加中文測驗嗎？怎麼這麼早就回來了？
lines.simplified: 你不是今天去台北参加中文测验吗？怎么这么早就回来了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì jīntiān qù Táiběi cānjiā Zhōngwén cèyàn ma? Zěnme zhème zǎo jiù huílái le?
lines.english: Weren't you going to Taipei for a Chinese test today? Why are you back so early?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別提了。火車在半路停了一個多小時，害我錯過了測驗的時間。
lines.simplified: 别提了。火车在半路停了一个多小时，害我错过了测验的时间。
lines.pinyin: Bié tí le. Huǒchē zài bànlù tíng le yí ge duō xiǎoshí, hài wǒ cuòguò le cèyàn de shíjiān.
lines.english: Don't ask. The train stopped halfway for over an hour, which made me miss the exam.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？你有沒有馬上跟他們聯絡，說明你的情況？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？你有没有马上跟他们联络，说明你的情况？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn? Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu mǎshàng gēn tāmen liánluò, shuōmíng nǐ de qíngkuàng?
lines.english: So what now? Did you get in touch with them right away and explain your situation?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我一下火車就打電話了。他們說這不是我的錯，讓我改到下個月考，不用再付錢。
lines.simplified: 我一下火车就打电话了。他们说这不是我的错，让我改到下个月考，不用再付钱。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yí xià huǒchē jiù dǎ diànhuà le. Tāmen shuō zhè bú shì wǒ de cuò, ràng wǒ gǎi dào xià ge yuè kǎo, búyòng zài fù qián.
lines.english: I called the moment I got off the train. They said it wasn't my fault and are letting me switch to next month's test without paying again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今天為什麼沒有參加測驗？
prompt.simplified: 男的今天为什么没有参加测验？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīntiān wèishénme méiyǒu cānjiā cèyàn?
prompt.english: Why didn't the man take the test today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huǒchē wǎn dào, tā méi gǎnshàng.
choices.english: The train was late, so he did not make it in time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他把測驗的日期記錯了
choices.simplified: 他把测验的日期记错了
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ cèyàn de rìqí jì cuò le.
choices.english: He got the date of the test wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 測驗的時間改到下個月了
choices.simplified: 测验的时间改到下个月了
choices.pinyin: Cèyàn de shíjiān gǎi dào xià ge yuè le.
choices.english: The test was moved to next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài Táiběi zǒu cuò le dìfāng.
choices.english: He went to the wrong place in Taipei.

questions.why: 火車在半路停了一個多小時，害我錯過了: the delayed train made him miss it. Only he moves to next month; the test itself was not moved, and he never got the date or the place wrong.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個週末我們要去海邊烤肉，你覺得會下雨嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个周末我们要去海边烤肉，你觉得会下雨吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen yào qù hǎibiān kǎoròu, nǐ juéde huì xià yǔ ma?
lines.english: We're going to the beach for a barbecue this weekend. Do you think it will rain?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我又不是上帝，怎麼會知道？妳看一下氣象預報吧。
lines.simplified: 我又不是上帝，怎么会知道？你看一下气象预报吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bú shì Shàngdì, zěnme huì zhīdào? Nǐ kàn yíxià qìxiàng yùbào ba.
lines.english: I'm not God; how would I know? Have a look at the weather forecast.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 預報說週末會下雨。我看我們還是改到下個週末好了。
lines.simplified: 预报说周末会下雨。我看我们还是改到下个周末好了。
lines.pinyin: Yùbào shuō zhōumò huì xià yǔ. Wǒ kàn wǒmen háishì gǎi dào xià ge zhōumò hǎo le.
lines.english: The forecast says it'll rain this weekend. I think we'd better move it to next weekend.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上次預報也說會下雨，結果出了一整天的大太陽。畢竟天氣變化很快，預報不一定對。我們多帶幾把傘不就好了？
lines.simplified: 上次预报也说会下雨，结果出了一整天的大太阳。毕竟天气变化很快，预报不一定对。我们多带几把伞不就好了？
lines.pinyin: Shàng cì yùbào yě shuō huì xià yǔ, jiéguǒ chū le yì zhěng tiān de dà tàiyáng. Bìjìng tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, yùbào bù yídìng duì. Wǒmen duō dài jǐ bǎ sǎn bú jiù hǎo le?
lines.english: Last time the forecast said rain too, and the sun blazed all day. After all, the weather changes fast, and the forecast isn't always right. Can't we just bring a few extra umbrellas?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gǎi dào xià ge zhōumò bǐjiào hǎo.
choices.english: Moving it to next weekend is better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Búbì gǎi rìqí, dài sǎn jiù xíng.
choices.english: No need to change the date; umbrellas will do.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng yùbào shuō bú xià yǔ zài qù.
choices.english: Wait until the forecast says no rain, then go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Búyòng dài sǎn, huì chū dà tàiyáng.
choices.english: No need for umbrellas; it'll be sunny.

questions.why: The woman proposes moving to next weekend; he answers that the forecast was wrong last time and asks 多帶幾把傘不就好了？, a polite no to her plan: keep the date and take umbrellas. Moving is her idea, and the sunny day was last time, not a forecast.

focus.en: after all; what a rhetorical question means

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 奶奶的手機壞了，妳怎麼不拿去修，反而買了一支新的？
lines.simplified: 奶奶的手机坏了，你怎么不拿去修，反而买了一支新的？
lines.pinyin: Nǎinai de shǒujī huài le, nǐ zěnme bù ná qù xiū, fǎn'ér mǎi le yì zhī xīn de?
lines.english: Grandma's phone broke. Why didn't you take it to be fixed instead of buying a new one?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 店裡說修要兩千五，新的才三千多。況且那支舊的已經用了八年，速度很慢，還常常出毛病。
lines.simplified: 店里说修要两千五，新的才三千多。况且那支旧的已经用了八年，速度很慢，还常常出毛病。
lines.pinyin: Diàn lǐ shuō xiū yào liǎngqiān wǔ, xīn de cái sānqiān duō. Kuàngqiě nà zhī jiù de yǐjīng yòng le bā nián, sùdù hěn màn, hái chángcháng chū máobìng.
lines.english: The shop said a repair would cost 2,500, and a new one is only a bit over 3,000. Besides, the old one is eight years old, slow, and often has problems.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這麼說也對。可是奶奶學得會用新手機嗎？
lines.simplified: 这么说也对。可是奶奶学得会用新手机吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō yě duì. Kěshì nǎinai xué de huì yòng xīn shǒujī ma?
lines.english: Put that way, you have a point. But can Grandma learn to use a new phone?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我已經教了她兩個下午，她現在連照片都會拍了。
lines.simplified: 我已经教了她两个下午，她现在连照片都会拍了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng jiāo le tā liǎng ge xiàwǔ, tā xiànzài lián zhàopiàn dōu huì pāi le.
lines.english: I've already taught her for two afternoons, and now she can even take photos.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒把舊手機拿去修？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没把旧手机拿去修？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme méi bǎ jiù shǒujī ná qù xiū?
prompt.english: Why didn't the woman get the old phone repaired?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店裡說舊手機修不好了
choices.simplified: 店里说旧手机修不好了
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ shuō jiù shǒujī xiū bù hǎo le.
choices.english: The shop said the old phone could not be fixed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai yìzhí xiǎng yào xīn shǒujī.
choices.english: Grandma had long wanted a new phone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde xiū jiù de bú tài zhídé.
choices.english: She felt fixing the old one wasn't worth it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīn shǒujī bǐ xiūlǐ hái piányí.
choices.english: A new phone was cheaper than the repair.

questions.why: He asks with 怎麼不……，反而…… why she bought instead of repairing. Her answer: a repair costs almost as much as a new phone, and 況且 the old one is slow, so repairing is not worth it. The shop could fix it (it quoted 2,500), and the new one costs more, not less.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳媽媽最近好像常常不在家？
lines.simplified: 你妈妈最近好像常常不在家？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ māma zuìjìn hǎoxiàng chángcháng bú zài jiā?
lines.english: Your mom seems to be out a lot lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她在學開車。她當了三十年家庭主婦，生活很單純，最大的願望就是自己開車回去看外婆。
lines.simplified: 她在学开车。她当了三十年家庭主妇，生活很单纯，最大的愿望就是自己开车回去看外婆。
lines.pinyin: Tā zài xué kāichē. Tā dāng le sānshí nián jiātíng zhǔfù, shēnghuó hěn dānchún, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiù shì zìjǐ kāichē huíqù kàn wàipó.
lines.english: She's learning to drive. She's been a housewife for thirty years and lives a simple life; her biggest wish is to drive herself back to see Grandma.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 學得順利嗎？
lines.simplified: 学得顺利吗？
lines.pinyin: Xué de shùnlì ma?
lines.english: Is it going well?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一開始很不順利，考了兩次都沒過。她說自己年紀大了，學不會了，差一點就不學了。
lines.simplified: 一开始很不顺利，考了两次都没过。她说自己年纪大了，学不会了，差一点就不学了。
lines.pinyin: Yì kāishǐ hěn bú shùnlì, kǎo le liǎng cì dōu méi guò. Tā shuō zìjǐ niánjì dà le, xué bú huì le, chà yìdiǎn jiù bù xué le.
lines.english: At first it went badly; she failed the test twice. She said she was too old to learn and nearly gave up.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那後來怎麼又願意繼續學了？
lines.simplified: 那后来怎么又愿意继续学了？
lines.pinyin: Nà hòulái zěnme yòu yuànyì jìxù xué le?
lines.english: So why did she go back to it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我爸爸一再跟她說，不必急，慢慢來就好。直到上個月又去考了一次，她才考過。
lines.simplified: 我爸爸一再跟她说，不必急，慢慢来就好。直到上个月又去考了一次，她才考过。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yízài gēn tā shuō, búbì jí, mànmàn lái jiù hǎo. Zhídào shàng ge yuè yòu qù kǎo le yí cì, tā cái kǎo guò.
lines.english: My dad kept telling her there was no rush, just take it slowly. Not until she took the test once more last month did she pass.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 考兩次沒過還繼續學，妳媽媽真不簡單。
lines.simplified: 考两次没过还继续学，你妈妈真不简单。
lines.pinyin: Kǎo liǎng cì méi guò hái jìxù xué, nǐ māma zhēn bù jiǎndān.
lines.english: Failing twice and still keeping at it: your mom is really something.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。上星期她第一次自己開車回外婆家，外婆高興得不得了。
lines.simplified: 对啊。上星期她第一次自己开车回外婆家，外婆高兴得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Shàng xīngqí tā dì yī cì zìjǐ kāichē huí wàipó jiā, wàipó gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Yes. Last week she drove herself to Grandma's for the first time, and Grandma was overjoyed.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的媽媽考了幾次才考過？
prompt.simplified: 女的妈妈考了几次才考过？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de māma kǎo le jǐ cì cái kǎo guò?
prompt.english: How many times did the woman's mother take the test before she passed?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dì yī cì jiù kǎo guò le.
choices.english: She passed the first time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kǎo le liǎng cì cái kǎo guò.
choices.english: She passed on the second try.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kǎo le sān cì cái kǎo guò.
choices.english: She passed on the third try.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kǎo le sì cì cái kǎo guò.
choices.english: She passed on the fourth try.

questions.why: She failed twice (考了兩次都沒過), and 直到上個月又去考了一次，她才考過: only the next attempt, the third, was a pass. "Two" is the number of failures, not of tries.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的媽媽後來為什麼又繼續學開車？
prompt.simplified: 女的妈妈后来为什么又继续学开车？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de māma hòulái wèishénme yòu jìxù xué kāichē?
prompt.english: Why did the woman's mother carry on learning to drive?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiānshēng yào tā bié zháojí.
choices.english: Her husband told her not to rush.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wàipó xīwàng tā zǎo diǎn kǎo guò.
choices.english: Grandma wanted her to pass soon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女兒一再要她再試一次
choices.simplified: 女儿一再要她再试一次
choices.pinyin: Nǚ'ér yízài yào tā zài shì yí cì.
choices.english: Her daughter kept asking her to try again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde niánjì bú shì wèntí.
choices.english: She felt age wasn't a problem.

questions.why: Asked why she went back, the daughter answers that 我爸爸一再跟她說，不必急: the encouragement came again and again from her husband. The daughter only tells the story, Grandma is only the goal, and the mother herself thought she was too old.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得女的媽媽怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得女的妈妈怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde nǚ de māma zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the woman's mother?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年齡太大，學開車太晚了
choices.simplified: 年龄太大，学开车太晚了
choices.pinyin: Niánlíng tài dà, xué kāichē tài wǎn le.
choices.english: She's too old; it's too late to learn to drive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shēnghuó guò de tài dānchún le.
choices.english: Her life is too simple.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很懂得照顧自己的家人
choices.simplified: 很懂得照顾自己的家人
choices.pinyin: Hěn dǒngde zhàogù zìjǐ de jiārén.
choices.english: She knows how to look after her family.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kǎo bú guò yě jiānchí xiàqù.
choices.english: She kept at it even after failing.

questions.why: 考兩次沒過還繼續學 praises her for failing twice and still going on learning. "Too old" was her own worry, the simple life is the daughter's description, and he says nothing about how she looks after her family.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳伯伯的麵店最近好像很熱鬧？
lines.simplified: 你伯伯的面店最近好像很热闹？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bóbo de miàndiàn zuìjìn hǎoxiàng hěn rènào?
lines.english: Your uncle's noodle shop seems very busy lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。以前客人大多是老鄰居。我們一再建議他在網路上放麵店的簡介，他都說沒什麼用，年輕人不會來吃。
lines.simplified: 对啊。以前客人大多是老邻居。我们一再建议他在网路上放面店的简介，他都说没什么用，年轻人不会来吃。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Yǐqián kèrén dàduō shì lǎo línjū. Wǒmen yízài jiànyì tā zài wǎnglù shàng fàng miàndiàn de jiǎnjiè, tā dōu shuō méi shénme yòng, niánqīngrén bú huì lái chī.
lines.english: Yes. Before, most customers were old neighbors. We kept suggesting he put an introduction to the noodle shop online, but he always said it was no use, young people would never come.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那他後來怎麼答應了？
lines.simplified: 那他后来怎么答应了？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā hòulái zěnme dāyìng le?
lines.english: So how come he agreed in the end?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 直到上個月，客人一天比一天少，有一天還不到二十個，他才發覺情況真的不太好，讓我幫他做。
lines.simplified: 直到上个月，客人一天比一天少，有一天还不到二十个，他才发觉情况真的不太好，让我帮他做。
lines.pinyin: Zhídào shàng ge yuè, kèrén yì tiān bǐ yì tiān shǎo, yǒu yì tiān hái bú dào èrshí ge, tā cái fājué qíngkuàng zhēn de bú tài hǎo, ràng wǒ bāng tā zuò.
lines.english: Not until last month, when customers got fewer by the day and one day there weren't even twenty, did he realize things really were bad, and he let me make it for him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 結果呢？
lines.simplified: 结果呢？
lines.pinyin: Jiéguǒ ne?
lines.english: And how did it go?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 說也奇怪，簡介放上網才一個星期，就有很多大學生來吃，晚上還得排隊。
lines.simplified: 说也奇怪，简介放上网才一个星期，就有很多大学生来吃，晚上还得排队。
lines.pinyin: Shuō yě qíguài, jiǎnjiè fàng shàng wǎng cái yí ge xīngqí, jiù yǒu hěn duō dàxuéshēng lái chī, wǎnshàng hái děi páiduì.
lines.english: Strangely enough, only a week after it went online, lots of college students started coming, and in the evening people even have to queue.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 伯伯一定很高興吧？
lines.simplified: 伯伯一定很高兴吧？
lines.pinyin: Bóbo yídìng hěn gāoxìng ba?
lines.english: Your uncle must be really happy?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 高興是高興，只不過他一個人忙不過來，作息也亂了，正在找人幫忙。
lines.simplified: 高兴是高兴，只不过他一个人忙不过来，作息也乱了，正在找人帮忙。
lines.pinyin: Gāoxìng shì gāoxìng, zhǐbúguò tā yí ge rén máng bú guòlái, zuòxí yě luàn le, zhèngzài zhǎo rén bāngmáng.
lines.english: Happy, yes; it's just that he can't keep up on his own, his daily routine is a mess, and he's looking for someone to help.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 伯伯後來為什麼答應放簡介？
prompt.simplified: 伯伯后来为什么答应放简介？
prompt.pinyin: Bóbo hòulái wèishénme dāyìng fàng jiǎnjiè?
prompt.english: Why did the uncle finally agree to put up an introduction?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiārén yízài zhèyàng jiànyì tā.
choices.english: His family kept suggesting it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店裡的生意越來越不理想
choices.simplified: 店里的生意越来越不理想
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de shēngyì yuè lái yuè bù lǐxiǎng.
choices.english: Business at the shop was getting worse.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大學生客人請他這麼做
choices.simplified: 大学生客人请他这么做
choices.pinyin: Dàxuéshēng kèrén qǐng tā zhème zuò.
choices.english: College-student customers asked him to.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo rén lái diàn lǐ bāngmáng.
choices.english: He wanted to find someone to help in the shop.

questions.why: 直到客人一天比一天少……他才發覺: he gave in only when business kept dropping. The family had suggested it again and again before and he still refused, the students came only after it went online, and he looks for a helper at the end.

focus.en: not until … did …; again and again

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 簡介放上網以後，店裡有什麼變化？
prompt.simplified: 简介放上网以后，店里有什么变化？
prompt.pinyin: Jiǎnjiè fàng shàng wǎng yǐhòu, diàn lǐ yǒu shénme biànhuà?
prompt.english: What changed at the shop after the introduction went online?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎo línjū dōu bù lái chī le.
choices.english: The old neighbors stopped coming.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bóbo qǐng dào rén bāngmáng le.
choices.english: The uncle has hired a helper.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng bǐ yǐqián zǎo guānmén.
choices.english: It closes earlier in the evening than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánqīng de kèrén biàn duō le.
choices.english: There are more young customers.

questions.why: A week after it went up, 很多大學生來吃: more young customers, the very people the uncle thought would never come. Nothing says the neighbors left, and he is still looking (正在找) for a helper.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by her last words?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 伯伯開心，可是太辛苦了
choices.simplified: 伯伯开心，可是太辛苦了
choices.pinyin: Bóbo kāixīn, kěshì tài xīnkǔ le.
choices.english: Her uncle is pleased, but it's too hard on him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 伯伯不喜歡年輕的客人
choices.simplified: 伯伯不喜欢年轻的客人
choices.pinyin: Bóbo bù xǐhuān niánqīng de kèrén.
choices.english: Her uncle doesn't like young customers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 伯伯覺得簡介沒什麼用
choices.simplified: 伯伯觉得简介没什么用
choices.pinyin: Bóbo juéde jiǎnjiè méi shénme yòng.
choices.english: Her uncle thinks the introduction is no use.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bóbo xiǎng ràng gèng duō xuéshēng lái.
choices.english: Her uncle wants even more students to come.

questions.why: 高興是高興，只不過他一個人忙不過來，作息也亂了: he is glad, but the extra work wears him out. 只不過 adds a cost, not doubt about the introduction; 沒什麼用 and his doubt about young people were his view before, and nobody says he wants still more customers.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位民眾您好，這裡是醫院一樓服務台。
lines.simplified: 各位民众您好，这里是医院一楼服务台。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi mínzhòng nín hǎo, zhèlǐ shì yīyuàn yī lóu fúwùtái.
lines.english: Good day, everyone. This is the hospital service desk on the first floor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 為了減少大家排隊等待的時間，從下個月一號起，醫院的掛號方式會做一些調整。
lines.simplified: 为了减少大家排队等待的时间，从下个月一号起，医院的挂号方式会做一些调整。
lines.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo dàjiā páiduì děngdài de shíjiān, cóng xià ge yuè yī hào qǐ, yīyuàn de guàhào fāngshì huì zuò yìxiē tiáozhěng.
lines.english: To cut the time everyone spends waiting in line, from the first of next month the hospital will make some changes to how appointments are made.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 以後來看病，請先上網填好基本資料，選好看病的時間，再照那個時間來醫院。
lines.simplified: 以后来看病，请先上网填好基本资料，选好看病的时间，再照那个时间来医院。
lines.pinyin: Yǐhòu lái kànbìng, qǐng xiān shàngwǎng tián hǎo jīběn zīliào, xuǎn hǎo kànbìng de shíjiān, zài zhào nàge shíjiān lái yīyuàn.
lines.english: From then on, please go online first, fill in your basic details and choose a time, then come to the hospital at that time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 假如您已經滿七十歲，又不方便上網，也可以到一樓服務台填一張表，我們會協助您辦理。
lines.simplified: 假如您已经满七十岁，又不方便上网，也可以到一楼服务台填一张表，我们会协助您办理。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎrú nín yǐjīng mǎn qīshí suì, yòu bù fāngbiàn shàngwǎng, yě kěyǐ dào yī lóu fúwùtái tián yì zhāng biǎo, wǒmen huì xiézhù nín bànlǐ.
lines.english: If you are already seventy and going online is hard for you, you can also fill in a form at the first-floor service desk, and we will help you book.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個月還可以跟以前一樣，到了醫院再掛號；下個月起，就沒辦法這樣做了。
lines.simplified: 这个月还可以跟以前一样，到了医院再挂号；下个月起，就没办法这样做了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège yuè hái kěyǐ gēn yǐqián yíyàng, dào le yīyuàn zài guàhào; xià ge yuè qǐ, jiù méi bànfǎ zhèyàng zuò le.
lines.english: This month you can still register on arrival as before; from next month that will no longer be possible.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 需要幫忙的民眾，請找穿白衣服的服務人員。謝謝大家的配合。
lines.simplified: 需要帮忙的民众，请找穿白衣服的服务人员。谢谢大家的配合。
lines.pinyin: Xūyào bāngmáng de mínzhòng, qǐng zhǎo chuān bái yīfú de fúwù rényuán. Xièxie dàjiā de pèihé.
lines.english: Anyone who needs help, please look for our staff in white. Thank you all for your cooperation.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是要告訴大家什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是要告诉大家什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào shì yào gàosù dàjiā shénme?
prompt.english: What is this announcement mainly telling people?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 醫院服務台搬到一樓了
choices.simplified: 医院服务台搬到一楼了
choices.pinyin: Yīyuàn fúwùtái bān dào yī lóu le.
choices.english: The service desk has moved to the first floor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánzhǎng de mínzhòng zěnme guàhào.
choices.english: How older people should book.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 去哪裡找醫院的服務人員
choices.simplified: 去哪里找医院的服务人员
choices.pinyin: Qù nǎlǐ zhǎo yīyuàn de fúwù rényuán.
choices.english: Where to find the hospital staff.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 醫院掛號的辦法要改了
choices.simplified: 医院挂号的办法要改了
choices.pinyin: Yīyuàn guàhào de bànfǎ yào gǎi le.
choices.english: The way to book at the hospital is changing.

questions.why: Every line serves one message: from next month booking works differently (調整 of the 掛號方式): online first, a desk for over-70s, walk-in only until the end of this month. The older people and the staff in white are each one line of it, and the desk was always on the first floor.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位七十五歲的先生不會上網，下個月要來看病。他應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位七十五岁的先生不会上网，下个月要来看病。他应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi qīshíwǔ suì de xiānshēng bú huì shàngwǎng, xià ge yuè yào lái kànbìng. Tā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A 75-year-old man cannot use the internet and will see a doctor next month. What should he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián yíyàng páiduì guàhào.
choices.english: Queue up to register as before.

choices.speaker: N

passage.traditional: 我伯伯過去在公司負責銷售。在我的記憶中，他每天忙得像打仗一樣，完全沒空管自己的身體。退休以後，他對健檢還是很{1}，總是說自己沒什麼{2}，不必去醫院。直到去年家人陪他做了健檢，他才知道身體早就發出了警告，也開始照醫生的建議{3}作息，每天早起走路、按時間吃飯，菜也煮得較淡，{4}連最愛的零食也不再吃了。他本來以為天天早起會很辛苦，說也奇怪，幾個月後他不但不覺得累，精神{5}比以前更好。現在，不少鄰居也跟著他每天早起走路，他成了大家的{6}。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo guòqù zài gōngsī fùzé xiāoshòu. Zài wǒ de jìyì zhōng, tā měi tiān máng de xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, wánquán méi kòng guǎn zìjǐ de shēntǐ. Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tā duì jiànjiǎn háishì hěn bèidòng, zǒngshì shuō zìjǐ méi shénme máobìng, búbì qù yīyuàn. Zhídào qùnián jiārén péi tā zuò le jiànjiǎn, tā cái zhīdào shēntǐ zǎojiù fāchū le jǐnggào, yě kāishǐ zhào yīshēng de jiànyì tiáozhěng zuòxí, měi tiān zǎoqǐ zǒulù, àn shíjiān chīfàn, cài yě zhǔ de jiào dàn, shènzhì lián zuì ài de língshí yě bú zài chī le. Tā běnlái yǐwéi tiāntiān zǎoqǐ huì hěn xīnkǔ, shuō yě qíguài, jǐ ge yuè hòu tā búdàn bù juéde lèi, jīngshén fǎn'ér bǐ yǐqián gèng hǎo. Xiànzài, bù shǎo línjū yě gēnzhe tā měi tiān zǎoqǐ zǒulù, tā chéng le dàjiā de bǎngyàng.
passage.english: My uncle used to handle sales at a company. In my memory, he was so busy every day it was like fighting a war, with no time at all to look after his own body. Even after retiring, he remained very passive about health checkups, always saying nothing was wrong with him and there was no need to visit a hospital. Not until his family took him for a checkup last year did he learn that his body had long been sending out warnings, and he began following the doctor's advice to adjust his daily schedule: waking early to walk, eating meals on time, cooking with lighter flavors, and even giving up his favorite snacks. He had expected rising early every day to be hard, but strangely enough, a few months later, not only did he not feel tired, his energy was actually better than before. Now quite a few neighbors get up early to walk with him every day, and he has become a role model for everyone.

Qùnián shèqū jiànjiǎn qíjiān, tā shùnbiàn zuò le jiǎnchá, běnlái yǐwéi méi shénme shì, méixiǎngdào yīshēng biǎoshì tā de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ bù fúhé biāozhǔn, yào tā gǎi chī wèidào dàn yìdiǎn de shíwù. Zuìchū, jiārén dōu bú yuànyì pèihé tā de xīn yǐnshí fāngshì, cháng zài wàimiàn mǎi yòu yóu yòu xián de dōngxi, hài tā yùdào bù shǎo cuòzhé. passage.english: Our neighbor Mrs. Chen is a homemaker whose life has always been simple; every day she only looks after her family and never noticed any health problems of her own. During last year's community health checkup, she went along for an exam, thinking nothing was wrong; unexpectedly, the doctor said her results did not meet the standard and told her to switch to food with a lighter taste. At first her family was unwilling to go along with her new way of eating and often bought oily, salty food outside, causing her a lot of frustration. However, she is very strong-willed and stuck with it to the end, working on dishes that were both healthy and tasty every day. Six months later, her family finally got used to the lighter flavor, and her checkup results returned to normal.

text.traditional:
為關心員工健康，本公司今年和合作醫院舉辦健康檢查，請先看下面的說明：
辦理期間：六月一日到六月三十日。請先上網填表，再按選好的日期到醫院辦理。
對象和費用：工作滿一年的員工，免費做基本健檢；年齡滿四十歲，而且工作滿三年的員工，免費做全身健檢。不符合免費條件的人，公司可以協助以優惠價格辦理。
請注意：檢查前一天晚上十點起，請不要吃東西，也避免做激烈運動，讓檢查結果更正確。
請假和改時間：檢查當天上午可請半天假，請先跟部門主管溝通，配合工作安排。假如當天有事沒辦法去，請最晚在檢查日的兩天前通知公司服務中心，服務中心會協助改時間。

Qǐng xiān shàngwǎng tián biǎo, zài àn xuǎn hǎo de rìqí dào yīyuàn bànlǐ. Duìxiàng hé fèiyòng: gōngzuò mǎn yì nián de yuángōng, miǎnfèi zuò jīběn jiànjiǎn; niánlíng mǎn sìshí suì, érqiě gōngzuò mǎn sān nián de yuángōng, miǎnfèi zuò quánshēn jiànjiǎn. Bù fúhé miǎnfèi tiáojiàn de rén, gōngsī kěyǐ xiézhù yǐ yōuhuì jiàgé bànlǐ. Qǐngjià hé gǎi shíjiān: jiǎnchá dāngtiān shàngwǔ kě qǐng bàn tiān jià, qǐng xiān gēn bùmén zhǔguǎn gōutōng, pèihé gōngzuò ānpái. text.english:
To care for employee health, our company is holding health checkups with our partner hospital this year. Please read the guide below first:
Checkup period: June 1 to June 30. Please fill in the form online first, then go to the hospital on your chosen date.
Eligibility and fees: Employees who have worked here at least one year get a free basic checkup; employees aged 40 or older who have also worked here at least three years get a free full-body checkup. For those who do not meet the free conditions, the company can help arrange a discounted rate.
Please note: Starting from 10 p.m. the night before your checkup, please do not eat anything and avoid vigorous exercise so the results are more accurate.
Leave and rescheduling: You may take a half-day off on the morning of your checkup; please talk with your department manager first to coordinate work arrangements. If something comes up and you cannot go that day, please notify the company service center no later than two days before your checkup date, and the service center will help change your date.

各位同事：
上個月新產品銷售期間，我們部門每天忙得像打仗一樣，討論工作也常常非常激烈。志明一向很堅強，平常頭痛或太累都說沒什麼，直到前天開會時突然全身很不舒服，才去醫院檢查。

Zhìmíng zuìchū jiānchí bù kěn qǐngjià, jīngguò zhǔguǎn yízài gōutōng, zǒngsuàn dāyìng cóng jīntiān qǐ xiūxí liǎng ge xīngqí. Zhè duàn qíjiān, tā fùzé de kèrén, wǒ hé Měilíng huì xiézhù chǔlǐ. text.english:
Dear colleagues,
During last month's new-product sales push, our department was busy every day as if fighting a war, and work discussions were often intense. Zhiming has always been strong-willed and brushed off headaches or exhaustion as nothing serious, until he suddenly felt terribly unwell all over in a meeting the day before yesterday and finally went to the hospital for an exam.
The doctor said he has nothing much wrong with him; it's just that his daily schedule has been irregular for years and he needs proper rest to recover soon. At first Zhiming insisted on not taking leave, and only after our manager talked with him again and again did he finally agree to rest for two weeks starting today.
During this period, Meiling and I will take care of his clients. If a client has something urgent, please tell me first and do not call to disturb him, so he can rest in peace.
Also, next Wednesday at 2 p.m. the hospital is coming to explain how to arrange basic health checkups, open to all employees. Anyone who wants to join please come to the first floor on time; you can fill out the form to sign up that day.
Jianhua

text.traditional:
很多上班族覺得，只要平時沒什麼不舒服，就不必花時間去做健康檢查。就算公司或家人一再建議，他們的態度還是很被動，常常因為工作太忙而不去。也有人擔心，一檢查就發覺身體有毛病，會影響本來安定的生活，所以不想知道。
不過，一位醫生表示，許多嚴重的病都是經過很長一段時間慢慢出現的。等一個人感覺不舒服時，身體其實早就發出警告了，想早日恢復健康就較困難了。一份對年齡滿四十歲民眾做的調查發現，檢查結果不符合健康標準的人之中，有不少人一向以為自己的生活習慣良好。新聞裡也常看到，有人僅僅四十多歲就不幸生了重病，甚至去世，教家人非常痛苦。
因此，基本或全身健檢的目的不是要讓人害怕，而是提供可靠的資料，幫助大家早一點發現小問題。假如一個人願意為了將來的健康而調整作息，把好習慣堅持到底，就能真正保護自己，讓健康成為生活的主角。
text.simplified:

text.pinyin: Hěn duō shàngbānzú juéde, zhǐyào píngshí méi shénme bù shūfú, jiù búbì huā shíjiān qù zuò jiànkāng jiǎnchá. Jiùsuàn gōngsī huò jiārén yízài jiànyì, tāmen de tàidù háishì hěn bèidòng, chángcháng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér bú qù. Yě yǒu rén dānxīn, yì jiǎnchá jiù fājué shēntǐ yǒu máobìng, huì yǐngxiǎng běnlái āndìng de shēnghuó, suǒyǐ bù xiǎng zhīdào. Búguò, yí wèi yīshēng biǎoshì, xǔduō yánzhòng de bìng dōu shì jīngguò hěn cháng yí duàn shíjiān mànmàn chūxiàn de. Děng yí ge rén gǎnjué bù shūfú shí, shēntǐ qíshí zǎojiù fāchū jǐnggào le, xiǎng zǎorì huīfù jiànkāng jiù jiào kùnnán le. Yí fèn duì niánlíng mǎn sìshí suì mínzhòng zuò de diàochá fāxiàn, jiǎnchá jiéguǒ bù fúhé jiànkāng biāozhǔn de rén zhīzhōng, yǒu bù shǎo rén yíxiàng yǐwéi zìjǐ de shēnghuó xíguàn liánghǎo. Xīnwén lǐ yě cháng kàndào, yǒu rén jǐnjǐn sìshí duō suì jiù búxìng shēng le zhòngbìng, shènzhì qùshì, jiào jiārén fēicháng tòngkǔ. Yīncǐ, jīběn huò quánshēn jiànjiǎn de mùdì bú shì yào ràng rén hàipà, ér shì tígōng kěkào de zīliào, bāngzhù dàjiā zǎo yìdiǎn fāxiàn xiǎo wèntí. Jiǎrú yí ge rén yuànyì wèile jiānglái de jiànkāng ér tiáozhěng zuòxí, bǎ hǎo xíguàn jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng zhēnzhèng bǎohù zìjǐ, ràng jiànkāng chéngwéi shēnghuó de zhǔjiǎo.
text.english:
Many office workers feel that as long as they do not feel unwell day to day, there is no need to spend time getting a health checkup. Even when their company or family suggests it again and again, their attitude stays passive and they often skip it because work is too busy. Some also worry that getting checked will uncover a health problem and upset their settled life, so they would rather not know.
However, a doctor points out that many serious illnesses develop slowly over a long period. By the time a person feels unwell, the body has in fact long since sent out a warning, making it harder to get well again soon. A survey of people aged forty and older found that among those whose results did not meet health standards, quite a few had always believed their lifestyle habits were good. In the news we also often see people who are merely in their forties fall seriously ill or even pass away, causing their families deep pain.
Therefore, the purpose of a basic or full-body checkup is not to frighten people, but to provide reliable information that helps everyone spot small issues earlier. If a person is willing to adjust their daily routine for their future health and stick to good habits to the end, they can truly protect themselves and make health the leading role in their life.

text.traditional:
在社會上，大家常欣賞堅強、不怕辛苦的人。在許多人的記憶中，不少上班族為了給家人安定的生活、當孩子的榜樣，而每天忙得像打仗一樣，遇到挫折也不肯休息。不管是為了銷售成績常常討論得很激烈的主管，還是生活單純、每天只管全家飲食的家庭主婦，他們都有相同的習慣：總是把工作和家人放前面，把自己放最後。
其實，努力工作不代表可以不管身體。年齡越大，假如平常不按時間吃飯，又不習慣吃較淡的食物，身體就會慢慢發出警告。很多人總是說沒什麼，直到生病得去辦理住院手續，或是聽到朋友僅僅四十多歲就不幸去世，才開始思考自己真正的願望是什麼。
最初，調整習慣很不容易，請家人或同事協助、配合，也常讓人覺得不好意思。不過，照顧好自己不是只想到自己：有健康的身體，才能一直陪著愛的人，也不會教家人擔心。別再被動地等到生病才改變，讓健康成為生活的主角，把良好的習慣堅持到底，也是在照顧家人。
text.simplified:

其实，努力工作不代表可以不管身体。年龄越大，假如平常不按时间吃饭，又不习惯吃较淡的食物，身体就会慢慢发出警告。很多人总是说没什么，直到生病得去办理住院手续，或是听到朋友仅仅四十多岁就不幸去世，才开始思考自己真正的愿望是什么。
最初，调整习惯很不容易，请家人或同事协助、配合，也常让人觉得不好意思。不过，照顾好自己不是只想到自己：有健康的身体，才能一直陪着爱的人，也不会教家人担心。别再被动地等到生病才改变，让健康成为生活的主角，把良好的习惯坚持到底，也是在照顾家人。
text.pinyin: Zài shèhuì shàng, dàjiā cháng xīnshǎng jiānqiáng, bú pà xīnkǔ de rén. Zài xǔduō rén de jìyì zhōng, bù shǎo shàngbānzú wèile gěi jiārén āndìng de shēnghuó, dāng háizi de bǎngyàng, ér měi tiān máng de xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, yùdào cuòzhé yě bù kěn xiūxí. Bùguǎn shì wèile xiāoshòu chéngjī chángcháng tǎolùn de hěn jīliè de zhǔguǎn, háishì shēnghuó dānchún, měi tiān zhǐ guǎn quánjiā yǐnshí de jiātíng zhǔfù, tāmen dōu yǒu xiāngtóng de xíguàn: zǒngshì bǎ gōngzuò hé jiārén fàng qiánmiàn, bǎ zìjǐ fàng zuìhòu. Hěn duō rén zǒngshì shuō méi shénme, zhídào shēngbìng děi qù bànlǐ zhùyuàn shǒuxù, huòshì tīngdào péngyǒu jǐnjǐn sìshí duō suì jiù búxìng qùshì, cái kāishǐ sīkǎo zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de yuànwàng shì shénme. Zuìchū, tiáozhěng xíguàn hěn bù róngyì, qǐng jiārén huò tóngshì xiézhù, pèihé, yě cháng ràng rén juéde bù hǎoyìsi. Búguò, zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ bú shì zhǐ xiǎng dào zìjǐ: yǒu jiànkāng de shēntǐ, cái néng yìzhí péizhe ài de rén, yě bú huì jiào jiārén dānxīn. Bié zài bèidòng de děng dào shēngbìng cái gǎibiàn, ràng jiànkāng chéngwéi shēnghuó de zhǔjiǎo, bǎ liánghǎo de xíguàn jiānchí dàodǐ, yě shì zài zhàogù jiārén.
text.english:
In society, people often admire those who are strong-willed and unafraid of hardship. In many people's memory, quite a few office workers live every day like fighting a war in order to give their families a stable life and be a role model for their children, refusing to rest even when facing setbacks. Whether it is a manager who often has heated discussions over sales results or a homemaker living a simple life who thinks only of her family's meals, they share the same habit: always putting work and family first and putting themselves last.
In fact, working hard does not mean you can ignore your body. As you get older, if you do not eat on time and are not used to eating lighter food, your body will gradually send out warnings. Many people always say it is nothing serious until they fall ill and have to handle hospital admission, or hear that a friend passed away at merely forty-something, before they begin to reflect on what their true wish is.
At first, adjusting habits is not easy, and asking family or colleagues to help and cooperate often feels awkward. However, taking good care of yourself is not thinking only of yourself: only with a healthy body can you keep accompanying the people you love and your family will not have to worry. Stop waiting passively until illness strikes to change; making health the leading role of life and sticking to good habits to the end is also a way of caring for your family.

choices.simplified: 自己慢慢调整作息，不去麻烦家人

choices.english: Adjust your routine slowly on your own, without troubling your family.

choices.traditional: 先把家人照顧好，再想自己的事
choices.simplified: 先把家人照顾好，再想自己的事
choices.pinyin: Xiān bǎ jiārén zhàogù hǎo, zài xiǎng zìjǐ de shì.

choices.traditional: 只要按時間吃飯，不必改別的習慣
choices.simplified: 只要按时间吃饭，不必改别的习惯
choices.pinyin: Zhǐyào àn shíjiān chīfàn, búbì gǎi biéde xíguàn.
choices.english: As long as you eat at regular times, there is no need to change other habits.

choices.traditional: 請家人配合，一起改變飲食

choices.pinyin: qǐng jiārén pèihé, yìqǐ gǎibiàn yǐnshí
choices.english: ask the family to go along and change the diet together

questions.why: Two parts together: paragraph 2 names two causes, irregular meals and food that is not light, and paragraph 3 says asking family to help and cooperate feels awkward but is part of caring for them, so D joins both. A avoids the very help paragraph 3 asks for, B is the put-yourself-last habit paragraph 1 criticizes, and C fixes only one of the two causes in paragraph 2.

focus.zh: 配合；作者的建議套用到做法
focus.en: to cooperate; applying the writer's advice
